cards.label: Principle
cards.title: Coherence
cards.front: Identity is more than a label.
cards.back: It is the maintained relationship among purpose, boundaries, permissions, memory, and action.

cards.label: Architecture
cards.title: Interface
cards.back: An explicit interface translates policy and purpose into bounded action on a substrate.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Capability
cards.back: A role should receive only the access it needs, with boundaries that can be inspected and reviewed.

cards.label: Architecture
cards.title: Composition
cards.back: Visible units, inputs, outputs, and transformations make emergent behavior easier to understand.

cards.label: Interpretation
cards.title: Myth and evidence
cards.back: Metaphor may illuminate values; evidence and explicit authority govern factual and operational claims.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Bounded exploration
cards.front: Safety can create freedom to learn.
cards.back: A bounded environment supports experimentation without silently inheriting unrestricted power.

cards.label: Principle
cards.title: Bounded agency
cards.front: Agency is more than choosing from a menu.
cards.back: Meaningful agency includes shaping frames, seeing alternatives, and challenging outcomes while legitimate consent, permission, evidence, safety, and rights constraints remain in force.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Evidenced readiness
cards.back: A consequential change becomes ready through validation, review, resolved objections, explicit promotion, and a credible recovery path.

cards.label: Principle
cards.title: Relation without control
cards.front: Context can deepen meaning without owning it.
cards.back: Relationships may inform interpretation, but they do not override agency, privacy, dissent, or revision rights; uncertainty cannot be used to conceal material risk.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Accountable commitment
cards.front: A promise is not a license.
cards.back: Commitments need attributable authority, evidence, challenge and amendment paths, consent, repair duties, and accountable release. Covenant language, if used, remains optional metaphor only.

cards.label: Architecture
cards.title: Governed ecology
cards.back: Bounded specialist roles contribute through explicit dependencies and shared governance. Personas are responsibilities or lenses, not sovereign minds or privileged truth authorities.

cards.label: Practice
cards.title: Name the status of a claim
cards.front: Not every output means the same thing.
cards.back: Proposals, decisions, test results, unresolved questions, authority requests, and publication records carry different evidential and authority weight.
